name: goal
description: Read or steer this session's long-task goal. action=get returns the goal plus the goal_id and revision every other action needs. action=create starts one for a genuinely long objective, never for single-turn work. action=edit|pause|resume|complete|blocked act on the current goal and need goal_id and revision copied from a get. create, edit, pause and resume only run on a turn a human started. complete and blocked also run inside the goal's own automatic round, where blocked needs blocked_reason and is refused before the minimum consecutive round count.

goal_id.description: Exact id returned by action get. Required by every action except get and create.

revision.description: Exact positive revision returned by action get. Required by every action except get and create.

objective.description: The concrete objective. Required with create, optional with edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive limit on automatic continuation rounds. Valid with create and edit.

blocked_reason.description: Concrete blocking condition. Required with blocked.
